dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Haha, I checked absolutely everything. Turns out I was right all along!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What were you checking?

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: The Nod-Krai power rankings, of course! Ever since the Fatui Harbingers descended on Nod-Krai, this has been the most talked-about topic at school.

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: When I take my findings back to Snezhnograd, I'm going to be the most popular kid on the block.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seeya.

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Haha... Hahaha!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Congratulations.

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: I'm sure you're excited to find out who's at the top of the Nod-Krai power rankings. Why don't you have a guess?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely it's the Second of the Fatui Harbingers?

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: No, no, no. "Second of the Fatui Harbingers." Sounds powerful, sure, but what has "The Doctor" ever actually accomplished?

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: You can't tell me a single thing, can you? That's because he's all bluster and no muster.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Surely it's not the Boss of the Curatorium of Secrets?

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: You're right, it's not. The treasure hunters around here might all be terrified of her, but when all's said and done, the Curatorium is still just an intelligence agency.

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: My guess is that if you stripped away her leverage and information, she'd just be a frail and helpless woman. I don't consider that real power.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It's me. It has to be me.

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Uhm... and who are you exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Alright, you win. As soon as you've made your name in Nod-Krai, I'll add you to my power rankings.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> appears to have something on her mind...)

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Hey, Jahoda! Over here! About the question I asked you last time, do you have an answer for me now?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I already told you I don't know...

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: How could you not know? Hurry up and tell me, just how powerful is Lady Nefer?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Powerful enough to order me around, that's for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: That doesn't sound very powerful at all... Oh well, the Curatorium of Secrets is still just an intelligence agency after all.

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Look, Jahoda. I've also included you in the combat power rankings.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Let me see... Hey! Did you put me at the very bottom of the list?!

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Heh heh... Hey, hey! Don't you dare toss dirt on me! Alright, alright, I'll move you up a few places!

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: *spitting sounds* Blech! Stop, that's enough already! When I head back to Snezhnaya, I might still need you to escort me.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Hmph. You're paying double the usual for that!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Come on, admit it. It's The Doctor, isn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Sure, he caused some pretty obvious damage, but he was only borrowing the power of the moons, wasn't he?

dialogues.speaker: Slazhnev
dialogues.text: Feats like that only prove how strong the moons' power is. Put him up against a true Moon Goddess, and he wouldn't stand a chance.
